Work Product created in the course of the project is the property of Client throughout.
findings.explanation: The contract gives the client ownership of your work as soon as it is created, which means you lose intellectual property rights before you are fully paid.
findings.suggested_change: Ownership of the Work Product shall remain with the Contractor until the Client has paid all fees due under this Agreement.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. I am reviewing the agreement and would like to propose a small adjustment before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, the current wording means intellectual property rights transfer before full payment is complete. I propose that ownership of the work product remains with the contractor until the client has paid all fees due under this agreement. Thank you for your time and understanding.
